name: io.github.adil-adysh/nvda-mcp-server
description: MCP server for interacting with NVDA via a local bridge for screen reader automation

environmentVariables.name: NVDA_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the NVDA bridge service (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8765)

environmentVariables.name: NVDA_BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Authentication token for NVDA bridge (optional if auto-discovered from %APPDATA%\nvda\nvda-mcp-bridge\token.key)
